task_completion.description: Create at least three new partition walls to define distinct zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Sweet Home 3D floor plan view, look for at least three newly drawn wall segments that divide the open loft space into smaller rooms or areas.

task_completion.description: Add at least four text labels identifying functional zones (e.g., Main Shooting Bay, Changing Room).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 2D floor plan view, look for at least four distinct text annotations labeling different areas of the studio.

task_completion.description: Furnish the studio with appropriate items (desks, chairs, storage, lighting).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 2D or 3D view, look for a variety of furniture items including desks/tables, seating, shelving units, and studio-specific lighting equipment (softboxes, umbrellas, or lamps).

task_completion.description: Generate a 3D photo rendering of the completed studio.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Create photo' dialog box being used in Sweet Home 3D or a final image viewer showing a high-quality rendered perspective of the furnished interior.

task_completion.description: Save the modified plan file and export the rendering to ~/Desktop/studio_3d_photo.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save' action in the File menu and a file explorer window or terminal command confirming the existence of 'studio_3d_photo.png' on the Desktop.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the studio rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the Sweet Home 3D wall tool, furniture catalog, and rendering menu.

integrity.description: The 3D photo was actually rendered within the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: Look for the rendering progress bar or the 'Create photo' configuration window within the Sweet Home 3D interface.

integrity.description: Labels were placed manually in the floor plan.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Create text' tool active or the text modification dialog box being used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a minimum of 3 new walls, 4 text labels, and a variety of furniture (desks, chairs, shelves, lighting). The final output must be a rendered PNG file named 'studio_3d_photo.png' on the Desktop. The pass threshold is 70/100. The starter file is 'photography_studio_starter.sh3d'.
